text_block_list.text:
With the Tulip Sho fast approaching. One 
day, before the Classic trial race—

The two unexpectedly bumped into each 
other at an intersection.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you. Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph—looks like you've arrived too. On my 
Tiara road!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You're planning on running in the Tulip 
Sho, right? I just finished registering 
myself a moment ago."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you're the one who picked a fight, 
so I just gave ya a little taste back.

—The Classic season is broadly divided 
into two paths: the "Triple Crown Route" 
and the "Tiara Route."

"While prep races don't draw a strict 
dividing line, the Tulip Sho serves as the 
gateway to the 'Tiara Route.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... You could have just watched 
quietly, but you had to barge right in."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What a total idiot. But if you get in my 
way, I won't show any mercy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look at you yapping and snapping like a 
puppy. You really don't know your place, 
do you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, you'd better practice crying your 
eyes out.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat did you say~!? You better have 
your best sour grapes ready, you hear me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll brush you aside in no time with my 
sublime front-running prowess!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oho, 'transcendent front-running 
power'—talk about talking big.

—Bumping into each other at the 
intersection, the two walked side by side 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but you're no match for my razor 
edge. They don't call me the Jackknife for 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, don't underestimate the Classic 
pace. If your stamina can't keep up, 
you're just a dull blade.

At first it was just an argument about the 
race, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you never clean your room 
properly! You're always leaving junk 
scattered all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talkin'! What's with those new 
pajamas?! Red floral print? Are there 
flowers blooming in your head or what?!

Eventually, it devolved into trading 
insults... It seems having been roommates 
meant they'd both bottled up quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well. On the day of the race, I'll 
teach her a lesson. That I'm superior in 
every single way!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Both my running and my sense, everything! 
I'll beat you, the biggest eyesore of them 
all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna wake YOU up. 
'Cause all you ever do is daydream.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's uncool to keep messing around with an 
old rival like you. I'm settling the score 
once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't you go taking back what you just 
said. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Brace yourself and come to Hanshin 
Racecourse!

The wind chases after Daiwa Scarlet's back 
as she walks away without looking back.

Even if we hold different goals, our paths 
crossing like this must be the destiny of 
rivals from the same generation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry about that, Trainer. Turned into a 
childish brawl back there.
choice_data_list: So you two are close, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what, who would ever! I don't care 
about that guy at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
However, having people constantly 
fluttering and clinging around me is 
pretty damn annoying.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer, before we head to the 
Derby, let's take that guy down real 
quick. Seems like that's what they want 
anyway!
